data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 164.113m. During 2023 there was a net gross release on prior years of approximately GBP 6.5m driven primarily by favourable claims development across older underwriting years. The syndicate notes that prior years had been impacted by large losses including the Ukraine conflict and a series of 2022 natural catastrophes (notably Hurricane Ian and US winter storm Elliott), however overall experience produced a modest release in 2023.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2021 YOA has closed with a profit of GBP 14.7m after all standard personal expenses, equivalent to a profit on stamp capacity of 9.8% The YOA has benefitted from a low incidence of natural catastrophes, although has been impacted by losses arising from the Ukraine conflict.

The 2022 YOA is forecast at the 24 months to make a mid-point profit of GBP 28.4m. Large losses impacting the YOA include the Ukraine conflict, and a series of natural catastrophes - the largest being Hurricane Ian and US winter storm Elliott.
Profit releases on open years of GBP 25.1m were made during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) taken from Technical Provisions movement table row 'Movement arising from prior years' (Gross = (6,471) i.e. a GBP 6.471m release). Opening gross claims taken from Technical Provisions 'Gross claims liabilities' 2022 comparative (164,113). No per-line-of-business prior year reserve movements are disclosed. The claims development triangle is reported in the notes (gross amounts in GBP 7000s); no RITC distortions called out for the prior year movement table. Some narrative figures (e.g. 'profit releases on open years GBP 25.1m') are net/presentation items and have not been used for the gross PYD figure.
